propositions: Structural test assertions on the shared confirmation reduce seam (_confirm.emit/emit_text) must verify that each verb routes exactly one line and that stdout contains only that line plus newline, with no output outside the seam, parametrized over create/link/transition plus no-op variants.

Verb inventory table (no-op-capable vs always-writes classification) must be curated in scripts/gen_cli_reference.py, rendered into generated docs/cli-reference.md, and drift-gated so that the CI build fails if a verb is added to rebar._cli._CONFIRM_SCOPE without classification.

Old-to-new confirmation-line mapping (pre-42cd70b889 to post-merge) must be recorded as a table in the generated docs/cli-reference.md, with old output strings extracted from git history rather than paraphrased.
Confirmation formatters must produce output without requiring a follow-up store read, verified by formatting with an empty temporary directory and REBAR_ROOT unset.
